sources.entry: Timer - Simple Timer app for Mac.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS timer app where you drag a handle to set a countdown, with notifications and keyboard-driven controls.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you set a timer on Mac by dragging a blue arrow; releasing starts it and clicking pauses it. When the time runs out, it shows a notification with a sound. New timers are created with CMD+N. Typing digits sets minutes, and a decimal point sets seconds, so 2.34 means 2 minutes 34 seconds. Keyboard shortcuts cover start/pause, restarting with the last timer, and adjusting time by one or ten minutes. The README says it was inspired by an older Minutes dashboard widget and built to work on retina displays.
use_cases: set a countdown timer on a Mac
cooking or kitchen timer on the desktop
notable: Drag-to-set timer: drag the blue arrow to choose the duration, release to start
Keyboard shortcuts for adding or subtracting one or ten minutes
keywords: set a timer on my mac
